knowledge.title: About the Bureau of Indian Standards
knowledge.summary: BIS is India's National Standards Body established under the BIS Act, 2016. Its activities include standards formulation, product certification, compulsory registration, foreign manufacturers certification, hallmarking, laboratory services, consumer activities, training and information services.

knowledge.title: Know Your Standard
knowledge.summary: BIS's Know Your Standard feature lets users search for an Indian Standard by IS number or keyword and access related information such as the standard document, amendments, gazette notifications, scheme of testing and inspection, licence information and laboratories associated with the standard.

knowledge.title: BIS Product Certification Licence — General Process
knowledge.summary: BIS states that the product certification process starts by identifying the applicable Indian Standard. Manufacturers then assess the required manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control and testing capabilities. BIS grants a licence after the applicable assessment and conformity requirements are successfully met. Applications are accepted online through the BIS portal.

knowledge.title: BIS Standards Search Portal
knowledge.summary: The official BIS standards portal provides a Know Your Standards search where users can search Indian Standards by number or keywords. The portal also provides links for published standards, new standards, revised standards and other standards-related resources.

knowledge.title: BIS Care licence and standards verification
knowledge.summary: The official BIS Care app supports Verify Licence Details for checking product authenticity, Know Your Standards for standards, licences and laboratories, Verify HUID for hallmarked jewellery, and Verify R-Number under CRS for covered electronic products.

standards.title: PVC insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables/cords
standards.summary: Polyvinyl chloride insulated unsheathed and sheathed cables/cords with rigid and flexible conductor for rated voltages up to and including 1 100 V. The BIS standard record identifies this standard as mandatory certification.

standards.title: Household and Similar Electrical Appliances — Safety Part 1
standards.summary: IS 302 (Part 1):2024 covers general safety requirements for household and similar electrical appliances and is aligned with IEC 60335-1:2020 under dual numbering.

standards.title: Plugs and Socket-Outlets for Household and Similar Purposes
standards.summary: IS 1293:2019 covers plugs and socket-outlets for household and similar purposes with rated voltage up to and including 250 V and rated current up to and including 16 A.

standards.title: Crosslinked polyethylene insulated PVC sheathed cables
standards.summary: Specification for crosslinked polyethylene insulated PVC sheathed cables for working voltages up to and including 1100 volts.

standards.title: Boxes and Enclosures for Electrical Accessories
standards.summary: Boxes and enclosures for electrical accessories for household and similar fixed electrical installations — general requirements.

certification.title: Identify the applicable Indian Standard
certification.summary: BIS says the application process starts with identification of the Indian Standard applicable to the product.

certification.title: Review manufacturing and testing capability
certification.summary: Manufacturers are expected to assess manufacturing infrastructure, process controls, quality control and testing capabilities against the relevant standard.

certification.title: Assessment and conformity
certification.summary: BIS states that assessment of manufacturing facilities and conformity to the relevant standard can involve third-party laboratory testing, testing at the manufacturing premises, or a combination, depending on the applicable route.

certification.title: Apply online through the BIS portal
certification.summary: BIS states that applications and payments for product certification are accepted online through its portal.

labs.name: Dynamic Test Laboratories LLP
labs.summary: BIS LIMS lists laboratory scope entries including IS 302 (Part 1):2024 and other electrical-appliance standards.

labs.name: Teknolab Quality Services Private Limited
labs.summary: BIS LIMS lists laboratory scope entries including multiple IS 302 appliance standards.

services.title: Know Your Standard
services.summary: Search Indian Standards by IS number or keyword and explore related standards information.

services.title: Product Certification Process
services.summary: Read official guidance for BIS product certification and Scheme-I procedures.

services.title: BIS Care App
services.summary: Official consumer app with licence, HUID, R-number and standards-related verification features.
